title: Hummus-Wrapped Energizer Rolls
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with the creamy richness of hummus, wrapped in crispy energizer rolls.
instructions: 1. Prepare the energizer by thawing it according to package instructions.
2. Prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions.
3. Lay the nori sheet flat and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto it.
4. Spread a thin layer of hummus on top of the rice.
5. Arrange cucumber, carrots, and avocado slices horizontally across the center of the nori.
6. Place the energizer on top of the vegetables, leaving a small border around it.
7. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and soy sauce over the energizer (if using).
8. Roll the nori tightly but gently to form a compact roll.
9. Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces using a sharp knife.
